gbifID.description: Global unique identifier for each Clarias gariepinus occurrence record in GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking each occurrence record to its source dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom for all records, consistently Animalia.

phylum.description: Taxonomic grouping at phylum level, uniformly Chordata across all records.

class.description: Class of the fish, always Teleostei, a taxonomic grouping of bony fishes.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Sil

family.description: Family classification of the species, consistently Clariidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded fish, consistently Clarias.

species.description: Taxonomic identifier for the fish, consistently Clarias gariepinus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet field is empty for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently set to species.

scientificName.description: Species name with author citation and year of description.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded fish species, consistently Clarias gariepinus.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: No data recorded for this field.

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO codes identifying the country where each occurrence was recorded.

locality.description: Locality information is absent for every occurrence record.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region where each Clarias gariepinus occurrence was observed.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation site.

individualCount.description: Number of individual fish observed per occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Publishing organization identifier for all records, constant UUID across dataset.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude of observation recorded in decimal degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of recorded coordinates expressed in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision information is missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation (meters above sea level) of observation site, data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy data not provided for any records.

depth.description: Depth measurement not recorded for any occurrence.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data is missing for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation timestamps ranging from 1965‑09‑10 to 2026‑06‑09, recorded in ISO‑8601 format.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from January (1) to December (12).

year.description: Observation year of the recorded Clarias gariepinus occurrence.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier code for Clarias gariepinus, consistently recorded as VRBD.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier code for Clarias gariepinus, constant value VRBD.

basisOfRecord.description: Record type showing observations were made by humans.

collectionCode.description: Record type identifier, consistently set to Observations for all entries.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this attribute.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Clarias gariepinus occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time of occurrence identification.

license.description: License type governing data reuse, such as Creative Commons variants.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Clarias gariepinus occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for this attribute in the dataset.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Interpretation timestamp of each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media format of the occurrence record, such as still images, videos, or audio files.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, or missing taxon identifier.

clarias_gariepinus.description: Occurrence records of Clarias gariepinus from 2002‑2026, with taxonomic, geographic, temporal, and observer metadata.

description: Records of Clarias gariepinus occurrences from 2002 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
